definitions.explanation: A private school offering supplementary education, often for exam preparation.

notes:
TYPES OF {塾|じゅく}:
- ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧{塾|じゅく} (general study cram school)
- ⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧{塾|じゅく} (exam prep cram school)
- ⟦{補習|ほしゅう}→補習：09603_hoshuu⟧{塾|じゅく} (supplementary tutoring)
- ⟦{個別|こべつ}→個別：11566_kobetsu⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧{塾|じゅく} (individual tutoring school)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塾|じゅく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ (to attend cram school)
- {塾|じゅく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to cram school)
- {塾|じゅく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ (cram school teacher)
- {塾|じゅく}⟦{代|だい}→代：28331_dai⟧ (cram school fees)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{予備校|よびこう}→予備校：04785_yobikou⟧ (prep school - for university entrance)
- ⟦{家庭教師|かていきょうし}→家庭教師：09291_kateikyoushi⟧ (private tutor)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{塾|じゅく} is integral to Japanese education. Many students attend after regular school hours to prepare for entrance exams or supplement school learning. The industry is significant, and famous {塾|じゅく} brands are well-known.
